In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
physical activity is beneficial to the health of older people and that it is important for them to remain physically active.
there is no evidence for the effectiveness of physical activity on mortality in the older population.
the current evidence supports the use of physical activity as a means of improving physical performance and preventing functional decline among older people.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
physical activity (PA) is a complex behavior with a complex association with health outcomes.
the trajectories of physical activity in older men are heterogeneous and are not associated with changes in physical performance.
the trajectories of PA are associated with physical performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we need to do a better job of understanding the relationship of physical activity to physical performance in older men, especially in terms of the types and intensities of physical activity that are important for maintaining physical performance.
the physical activity trajectory is an important predictor of change in physical performance in older men.
the benefits of physical activity on health and physical performance are not linear.
